title: Evaluator run
statement: A run on a finite Boolean input processes its symbols from left to right, starting from a given evaluator configuration. At each symbol it takes one evaluator step; if that step returns a new configuration, the run continues on the remaining input, and if it returns an output Boolean, that Boolean is the result. Once the input is exhausted, the evaluator takes a step with an absent symbol; if that step returns a configuration, the result is false, and otherwise its output Boolean is the result.
